evaluator: AI diagnostic judge (SAME model that generated the arms — see limitation). NOT market validation.
critical_limitation: This benchmark was generated AND judged by one model. True arm independence (§9) and an unbiased blind judge are NOT achievable in a single-agent run: the model saw all arms. Treat scores as directional diagnostics only. Real human target-buyer evaluation is REQUIRED and is NOT provided here (§28/§51).
forced_choice_ai_judge: OUTPUT_Y (LeadLens) — on decision discipline, honesty/abstention, counterevidence and a defensible validate-first action. BUT OUTPUT_Z (Claude+Vibe) is close and WINS on currentness + commercial access (dated+priced deals + named contacts).
honest_caveat: A real BD leader optimizing for immediacy may PREFER OUTPUT_Z: 'SPX did ~$900M of deals in 2026, here are two names' is act-on-able in a way LeadLens's 'validate whether external PMI is used' is not (§57/§58 tension). The AI judge rewards rigor; buyers may split. Do NOT read Y's higher total as a market result.
verdict: ROUGH PARITY (diagnostic), mixed by job: LeadLens ahead on decision discipline/trust; Claude+Vibe ahead on currentness/access. Outcome D + B.
